definitions.split_coverage: successfully parsed and canonicalized POI-warhead splits / unique valid generated PROTACs, computed per POI
definitions.warhead_uniqueness: unique generated POI warheads / successfully split unique generated PROTACs, computed per POI
definitions.warhead_diversity: mean pairwise Morgan-Tanimoto distance among unique generated warheads from the same POI
definitions.warhead_novelty: unique generated warheads absent from TRAIN warheads for the same POI / unique generated warheads for that POI
